title: Victorian Christmas village
description: A snowy Victorian Christmas village on an 840 x 420 mm base of 8 magnet-jointed tiles: a one-piece church hollowed for a puck light, an inn, bakery, cottages and houses for FDM, plus a 160 mm tree, lamps, firs and figures for resin. Built with the scene workflow using Meshy meshes (1012 credits). The base tiles have been printed.
material: White PLA and resin, hand painted

components.name: Buildings: one-piece church, B3 house body and roof, bakery, inn, B1 and B6 cottages
